title: Cable Gifts
subtitle: Gifts users buy with their points. The Cable team fulfils every order.

typeHint.Physical: Delivered or picked up — the team contacts the user.
typeHint.ChargeCredit: Arranged by the team by hand.
typeHint.Voucher: The voucher code is shown to the user once fulfilled.

form.endsBeforeStart: The end must be after the start
form.imageType: Only jpg, png or webp images are allowed

orders.title: Gift orders
orders.subtitle: Fulfil or cancel orders. Cancelling refunds all the points and returns the piece to stock.
orders.fulfillHint: Optional note shown to the user in "My gifts" (e.g. pickup details).
orders.fulfillVoucherHint: Enter the voucher code — the user sees it in "My gifts" with a copy button.
orders.cancelHint: All {{points}} points go back to the user's wallet and the piece returns to stock. The user gets a notification.
